name: Spotify Web
description: Search Spotify's catalogue beside Songstress's Spotify, open its links, and fill a track with the ISRC Spotify keeps.
about: Spotify Web searches Spotify's catalogue through its web player, beside the Spotify connection Songstress has of its own, and opens Spotify links (open.spotify.com, play.spotify.com and spotify: links) as their pages.
It also fills in a track's **ISRC**, the code that names one recording, from what Spotify keeps, which helps Songstress match a song across sources.
useCases: Search Spotify's catalogue with no Spotify account.
Open a Spotify link someone sent you.
Match a song across sources by its ISRC.
howItWorks: Your server opens an anonymous session with Spotify's web player, as a browser would, and keeps it until its tokens expire. Searches, lookups and metadata go from your server to Spotify with it.
For a track's id elsewhere, it asks Deezer by the track's ISRC. It finds and opens music: it doesn't play or download it. Its results sit beside Songstress's own sources, never in their place.
